about: The load-failure contract (the restructure, step 2, 2026-11-26; RESTRUCTURE-PLAN.md section 6): what one page file that cannot be loaded may take down.
Every page script in index.html is listed with its class and its feature group; tests/modload.test.js checks it (404 of each file on Chromium and WebKit, and the imports read from the files).

on404: what its 404 shows where that is not its class's usual: "card" (the start-up card), "no-picture" (Today drawn without its outfit figure), "picture" (Today drawn with it: the mannequin or the painted picture) or "painted" (Today drawn, its only figure the painted picture: "picture" once painted, "no-picture" where the painter is late or does not paint); a string for both engines, or {chromium, webkit}.

needs (the owner's rule 3, 2026-11-27; the restructure S6c): a group -> the groups it may import from, which it then fails with: a 404 of a needed group's file takes the needing group's files that import it down too. Not handed on: a group may import only the groups it names itself.

absent (the owner's decision D1, 2026-11-27; the notice board made clean, N2): the parts a file's 404 now leaves out where main threw (they were bus.js `need` calls; now the file's hooks, bus.js register): each one's moment (hook), the part, and the socket it was (was). A file that didn't load registered nothing, so core goes on without its parts: start-up, Settings, Insights and Today no longer stop there. tests/modload.test.js checks that each is the file's hook and no socket any more, and that the file's 404 shows no error naming it.

required.what: the app cannot start without it: its failure may show the start-up card. It may import only required files.

today-no-picture.what: without it Today is drawn with no outfit picture, never the start-up card. It may import required and today-no-picture files, never an optional one.

optional.what: only its feature is lost (its group may fail together, and so may a group that needs its group); Today is drawn with its picture. It may import required and today-no-picture files, the files of its own group and those of a group its group needs (needs). No required or today-no-picture file imports it: they reach it through bus.js (an announcement, or a socket: serve/ask).

groups.today: Today and the plan behind it
groups.painter: the outfit picture: drawn figure, mannequin poses, the painter
groups.add: the Add page and its readings
groups.item-sheet: the item sheet and the Wardrobe grid
groups.backup: sync, its photos and status, snapshots, backup files
groups.(a file's own name): a feature that is one file

merge.js.note: without merge.js the backups stop (sync merges with its rules) and a change that is saved fails, as it did (the stamps are merge.js's); start-up goes on and the stored settings are applied, not keyed (core.js takeSettings, the restructure S6h; from S6f to S6h start-up failed: core.js cleanSettings read merge.js's SET_META, which bus.js now has too)

who.js.note: who is connected (from account.js and sync-status.js, the restructure S3b)

photo-keys.js.note: the photo keys and the kept pictures (from photos.js, the restructure S3b): as photos.js, without it Today has no outfit picture

mannequin.js.note: without it Today has no mannequin: its only figure is the painted picture, there once the painter has painted (late on a busy machine; not on Windows WebKit, whose healthy page showed no painted picture in the lab survey)

mq/vest.js.note: as mannequin.js: without the pose of the day's outfit Today has only the painted picture; modload holds the day on Monday 2026-11-16, whose outfit has a vest (on Thursday 2026-11-26 it is mq/suit.js)

act.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c): as toast.js

days.js.note: the day records (from history.js, the restructure S3b): as history.js, without it Today has no outfit picture

toast.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c), 2026-11-25: its 404 shows the start-up card since the restructure S5d and S5e (settings.js and start.js import it); before, Today with its picture

nav.js.note: the router (show, subOpen, openAdd, pagesOn), split out of start.js (the restructure S3f): start-up cannot show Today without it

ui.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c) (its questions): as toast.js

look-base.js.note: the Look beta's switch, types and values (from look.js, the restructure S5d): colpick, checklist, add-card and own-lists import it

asm-keys.js.note: the color-coded masters' version, kinds and keys (from asm-color.js, the restructure S4): assemble.js and draw.js read it, and without it Today has no outfit picture (measured on both engines)

asm-look.js.note: a look's painted cloth and keys, worked out on the page (from assemble.js and asm-keys.js, the restructure S6p): as assemble.js

asm-cm-job.js.note: a look's job for the color-coded painter, worked out on the page (from asm-color.js, asm-watch.js, asm-pocket.js, asm-kinds.js and asm-ocp.js, the restructure S6p)

asm-today.js.note: Today's painted pictures on the page: kept, fetched, built ahead, the start-up sync (from assemble.js, the restructure S6p): as assemble.js

asm-cm-page.js.note: the color-coded painter's page parts: the manifest, warming, Today's hook, Settings' rows (from asm-color.js, asm-gl.js, asm-kinds.js and asm-ocp.js, the restructure S6p)

sync.js.note: as mannequin.js: without it Today has only the painted picture

calparse.js.note: not a page script: calendar.js imports it with import() when a calendar is read

asked.what: N5 (the notice board made clean, 2026-11-28; the owner's decision D1): the sockets a required or today-no-picture file asked of an optional file with bus.js `need`, now `ask` (or `served`): without the file the asking code goes on without its part, where main threw. files: the optional file -> each socket and the files that ask it. kept: the `need` calls toward an optional file that stay, and why. tests/modload.test.js checks both lists against the files, and that each listed file's 404 shows no error naming one of its sockets (both engines).

pickscore.js.why: Suggest another and the piece picker are pickscore.js's scoring: with no clean way to swap or pick without it, the tap still says "Something went wrong" (safety.js), as on main

today-photofold.js.why: a piece's photo opens and shuts only through today-photofold.js: the tap on a row or a tile still says "Something went wrong", as on main

analysis.js.why: Insights' planned outfits are counted over analysis.js's days: without it the counts would be wrong, so the Insights tab still says "Something went wrong", as on main

safety.js.why: why a tagging request failed is safety.js's words: without them the card would say it failed with no reason, so the request still throws to its caller, as on main
